title: Part 66 : 2023: Petroleum And Its Products -Methods Of Test - Part 66 Flash Point (Open) And Fire Point By Modified Pensky-Martens Apparatus
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the method of test for the determination of the open cup flash point and the fire point of petroleum products, paints and varnishes which have open cup flash point in the range of 40 °C to 370 °C.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Petroleum and its Products - Methods of Test, Part 21: Flash Point (closed) by Pensky Martens Apparatus
Primary Aluminium Ingots for Remelting for Aircraft Purposes

clause_3_terminology: And Fire Point By Modified Pensky

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
